Results.ReviewText: Easy to use and portable. Cooks evenly and easy to clean up. Love it!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: We wanted something compact and easily transportable with our new RV and we found it! Combined with the stand, our new Q makes this Weber Crew fully mobile ; quick heating and cooler running than the big boys, but for a casual grill out it is perfect!
Results.Title: Great portable grill

Results.ReviewText: I Love this grill! It's my first gas grill. It's so easy to use and works GREAT!!
Results.Title: Gas Grill

Results.Title: Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText:
Been using Weber grills my whole life  !
They are simply the best grills to buy
Results.Title: Super Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great BBQ and just the right size for our apartment.
Results.Title: A little goes along way!

Results.ReviewText: I've wanted a Q series for a long time. Awesome grill. Perfect size great cooking.
Results.Title: Weber Q is awesome!

Results.ReviewText: Best Grill ever! - Perfectly Sized - Heats up in no time - So much Fun - Grills beautifully
Results.Title: Heats Up in No Time

Results.ReviewText: This grill was easy to set up and clean. It’s also very portable due to weight.
Results.Title: Very Portable, easy to clean

Results.ReviewText: I am really enjoying my new grill. I bought it for camping and it is just the perfect size to grill for two or four people. Easy to use and clean. I recommend this grill for anyone. Mine is blue and it is pretty.
Results.Title: Q1200 grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is the perfect size for my patio and really delivers on quality. This is my second one, and my first one (10 years old) was still in such great working order I could hand it down to a friend. I was ready to treat myself to a later model and a different color...and it does not disappoint!
Results.Title: Small and Mighty

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! We appreciate you providing your feedback regarding the Q1200. It is unfortunate to hear your disappointment on the tables. If you need anything please reach out to us by phone at 800-446-1071 or by email at support@weberstephen.com. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: It does a fine job, for the bbq'ing portion of things but the folding side platforms are weak and won't hold much weight.  This is my second Q-grill and I had so hoped that feature would have somehow improved.... but I was wrong.  Other than that, a good little grille.
Results.Title: Almost really good:)

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, We are very sorry to see this damage on your Q Lid. We have responded to a request you submitted to us. Regards
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: This grill is very weak. The wind managed to topple the grill resulting in four cracks on the "titanium lid" and resulted in an unusable grill. Super disappointed in Weber's "quality".
Results.Title: Lid cracked after wind toppled grill

Results.ReviewText: Nice little grill.  I bought mine because my brother loves his.
Results.Title: GREAT LITTLE GRILL

Results.ReviewText:
Despite a handful of review criticisms tegarding the regulator, this grill has performed well.  Heats to temperature quickly, adjusts low enough to grill slowly, if desired. 
I'm particularly fond of the ease of clean up, and that it packs up ideally for my RV adventures.
Results.Title: Top performer

Results.ReviewText: It is so easy to use and so easy to clean. It cooks perfectly every time! It is a perfect size, not too big, not too small. I love it!
Results.Title: The Perfect Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Hello Stephen, We are sorry to hear about your experience with our Q 1200 regarding the grill being too hot. We have reached out to you over E-mail to further assist.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: After five charred meals, the grill now resides in the trash can. I cleaned the grill each time, and had the gas temp set to the lowest temperature. Every type of food stuck to the grate and was charred. The thermometer said 300 F, but the grate was obviously much hotter. If you like well charred food, then this is the grill for you.
Results.Title: Don't buy !!

Results.ReviewText: Works great, small and portable, easy clean up.  Just perfect for our raving needs!!
Results.Title: Q 1200 Grill

Results.ReviewText: Very convenient, patio/condo grill. Well made. Only issue at this time is the availability of fuel!
Results.Title: Q1200 grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this little grill. I bought one about ten years ago when we got our camper and I loved it. Still use it when we go camping but I had a big old gas grill and I just wanted a little one like we have in camper and I found it at Lowe’s for a really good price and I grabbed it. It’s on my back porch and so easy to grill on it for two people. Love my little grill.
Results.Title: My little Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: Great for a boat , camping and rv - portable and easy to use.
Results.Title: Weber q

Results.ReviewText: Well made, perfect for our needs. We also purchased the stand and the adapter to hook up a larger size LP tank.
Results.Title: Great small grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my fourth Weber grill.  My first was a charcoal kettle grill nearly fifty years ago that I received as wedding gift.  It was a great grill and it was used for many years until it was replaced with another charcoal kettle grill.  Finally, I got tired of the charcoal and lighter fluid hassle and purchased my first Weber Q nearly ten years ago.  It served me well as I no longer needed the larger sized grill.  I moved to Florida recently and gave my baby Q to one of old neighbors.  Soon after moving here to Florida I purchased my newest Weber grill, a beautiful red baby Q.  It is the best yet!  Several improvement and modifications have been made and I just love my new grill even more than the others preceding it.
Results.Title: I love my baby "Q"

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill so much. It's all I use at home. My son also will take it with him for camping and cooking outside after XC skiing. I've had it for a year now. Works great. So happy with it and doesn't take much room on my little balcony.
Results.Title: Happy little grill

Results.ReviewText:
This thing is an amazing performer, even with it’s small stature! Easily packs away for picnics and camping. Maintains consistent heating, even with frequent openings of the lid, due to its robust cast iron non stick grates. It’s easy to use, and easy to clean. 
This grill is by far the best grill I’ve owned for camping.
Thank you Weber for your help in making me a life long believer in your products!
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, We are very sorry to hear about your Q having issues with getting hot. We are reaching out to you to better assist. Thanks.
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Doesn't get hot enough. Worked great the first time. Doesn't now
Results.Title: Won't get hot enough.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to Start.  Easy to use. Right size for desired location.
Results.Title: Nice Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for 2 people. Fits in small spaces. Very easy to clean. Cooks excellent. Love this grille
Results.Title: Excellent Gas Grille

ClientResponses.Response: We are sorry to hear you're having some trouble with your flame height on the Q1200. Our support team will reach out to you via email to troubleshoot and provide you with a solution. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: It seems that the flames on the burner at full does not get very high it is almost looks like  it is med low and wont  get any higher I have tried different stove to the propane and it burns high went set at high and med at medium. Don’t know if Webber 1200 is faulty?
Results.Title: Poor flame height

Results.ReviewText: I have been using this grill for five years and it’s the best BBQ I have ever owned. We use it when travelling to Florida where we spend our winters, it so compact you can take it anywhere and cooks a meal for four people.  At home we use if for our appetizer BBQ to supplement our larger grill when we have a crowd of people.
Results.Title: Greatest Travel Grill

ClientResponses.Response: Hi, We do appreciate that, We hope you enjoy the grill. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Sorry other than lighting it and heating it up I have not cooked anything.
Results.Title: 1200q

Results.ReviewText: Grill was perfect to take camping with us for roughly 8 days, was super convenient to come back to base camp and not have to make a fire and wait to make food. We chose to just bring the full size 20lb propane tank since we were staying in areas 2-3 days highly recommend this grill
Results.Title: Perfect travel grill

Results.ReviewText: Love the flexibility. Easy to clean. Compact to store. What’s not to love!
Results.Title: I should have gotten one sooner

Results.ReviewText: Easy turning on and off, easy set up. Just the right size for my husband and I and occasionally few visitors. Fast cooking too.
Results.Title: My dream grill.

Results.ReviewText: I have had a Q 100 for 11 years that I used 3-4 time per week while out in our RV (150 days per year). I replace the burner tube 3 years ago and the regulator last year. It performed well, but....we now full time in our new RV and decided a new BBQ was in order. I bought the Q 1200 because of past experience and its compact size. I am really enjoying the fold out table arms and the built in thermometer. I feel like I have better control over heat and my wife swears our meals have improved. So far I am loving this new Q and remain an ardent fan of Weber products.
Results.Title: Ardent 'Q' fan

Results.ReviewText: This is the best all around portable grill.  It works really well on the deck too
Results.Title: Q 1200 Weber grill

Results.ReviewText: I am a confirmed charcoal grill man, but I needed a portable grill for camping. I did not want to have to deal with hot coals or having to carry a large bag of coal, etc. while on the go. This grill cooked a ribeye on day 1 just like I prefer doing it so easily and with none of the normal grill hassles. It will travel all over the USA with me in the years ahead.
Results.Title: Easy peasy

Results.ReviewText: Very practical, easy to clean. Also very easy to move and store.
Results.Title: Convenient, mobile and great quality
